{{Quote|The Empire has improved my business. No more space pirates on the run to the Rutan system.|A pilot|<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]''</ref>}}
The '''Rutan system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] close to the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. It included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rutan/Legends|Rutan]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Senali]].
